item.title: Blast Security: $10 Million Seed Round Raised To Launch Preemptive Cloud Defense Platform
item.description: Blast Security has emerged from stealth with a $10 million seed round, introducing a preventive approach to cloud risk mitigation that aims to replace the industry’s longstanding reliance on reactive detection. The round was co-led by 10D and MizMaa Ventures, marking one of the notable early-stage cybersecurity financings this quarter.

item.title: Sterling Investment Partners: $1.6 Billion Fund V Closed
item.description: Sterling Investment Partners has closed its fifth institutional private equity fund at more than $1.6 billion, marking one of the firm’s largest capital raises to date and reflecting strong investor demand for its middle market investment strategy. The fund surpassed its original $1.25 billion target and reached its hard cap within months of launching, bolstered primarily by returning limited partners while also attracting several new global institutional backers.

item.title: J.P. Morgan Asset Management: $1 Billion Raised For Second Co-Investment Fund
item.description: J.P. Morgan Asset Management’s Private Equity Group has closed its second dedicated co-investment vehicle, PEG Co-Investment Fund II, with $1 billion in commitments, surpassing its original $750 million target. The raise includes capital from the PEG team and represents a significant expansion of the group’s long-standing co-investment program focused on small- and middle-market buyouts.

item.title: Revolut: $75 Billion Valuation Achieved Following Major Secondary Share Sale
item.description: Revolut has completed a significant fundraising round through a large secondary share sale, valuing the global fintech company at $75 billion, marking one of the highest valuations ever achieved by a private financial technology business. The transaction attracts a broad syndicate of established institutional investors, provides substantial liquidity to employees, and advances the company’s long-term expansion strategy.

item.title: Willdan Enhances Municipal Advisory Capabilities With Acquisition Of Compass Municipal Advisors
item.description: Willdan Group has announced a significant expansion of its municipal financial services with a definitive agreement for its subsidiary, Willdan Financial Services, to acquire Compass Municipal Advisors, an independent municipal advisory firm based in the Southeastern United States. The deal, expected to close on January 1, 2026, pending customary conditions, will broaden Willdan’s reach and bolster its technical and financial capabilities for public agencies nationwide. item.title: Majesco To Acquire Vitech In Major Insurance Technology Deal
item.description: Majesco has agreed to acquire Vitech in a transaction that will create one of the largest and most advanced technology partners serving the Group and Benefits, as well as Retirement and Pension markets. The deal strengthens Majesco’s position as a leader in cloud-native and AI-native software across both the Property and Casualty segment and the Life and Annuity and Health segment.

item.title: Raptor Power Systems: Recap Completed Via Guardian Capital Partnership
item.description: Guardian Capital Partners has completed a majority recapitalization of Raptor Power Systems, marking a significant expansion of its digital infrastructure investment strategy. The transaction brings together Guardian, EA Advisors, and Raptor’s founding family to support the Company’s next stage of growth as data center development and power reliability needs rapidly intensify across the United States.

item.title: Nest Health: $22.5 Million Series A Raised To Advance Nationwide Expansion Of Whole-Family Medicaid Care
item.description: Nest Health has closed its Series A funding round at more than $22.5 million as the Louisiana-based provider of whole-family Medicaid care positions itself for its next stage of product development and multistate growth. The company, which delivers medical, behavioral, and social care directly into the home, has gained meaningful traction among families facing barriers to traditional care as well as among payers seeking improved outcomes and reduced costs.

item.title: WarRoom Cellars Completes Acquisition Of SIMI Wine Brand
item.description: WarRoom Cellars has acquired the storied SIMI wine brand from The Wine Group, marking one of the Central Coast company’s most significant expansions as it continues building a portfolio of heritage wine labels positioned for renewed consumer relevance and market growth.

item.title: ING Bank Śląski Moves To Full Ownership Of Goldman Sachs TFI
item.description: ING Bank Śląski has agreed to purchase the remaining 55% stake in Goldman Sachs TFI from Goldman Sachs, giving the bank full ownership of one of Poland’s largest asset management firms. ING, which already holds 45% of the company through its subsidiary ING Investment Holding, will acquire the outstanding stake for PLN 396 million, equal to approximately €93 million at the current exchange rate. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2026 pending standard regulatory approvals.
